items.headline: Two exploited NetScaler zero-days: one in default configuration, one on by default on VPN servers; no workaround

immediate_action.action: Citrix confirms CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 are being exploited against unmitigated NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances right now, and Google's Mandiant reports exploitation since at least early September. CVE-2026-88771 requires no configuration at all: every default deployment is reachable by an unauthenticated attacker; CVE-2026-88772 is reachable wherever DTLS is enabled, which Citrix states is the default on any VPN virtual server. Citrix lists no workaround, and Mandiant's interim network controls (disable DTLS where it is not needed, block inbound UDP/443 upstream) cover CVE-2026-88772 only. Capture forensic evidence (logs, an instance snapshot where the appliance is virtual, a support bundle, a core dump) from each exposed appliance before patching, since the upgrade itself can destroy evidence of prior compromise, then upgrade to 14.1-73.37+ or 13.1-64.23+ (run `show ns variable` first on 13.1; if it returns any variables, install 13.1-64.24 instead to avoid a known reboot loop), going straight to 14.1-73.41+ or 13.1-64.28+ where the appliance is configured as a SAML service provider or identity provider (CVE-2026-88779), and to 14.1-73.46+ or 13.1-64.29+ where it is an identity provider (CVE-2026-107406), and run a compromise assessment on every appliance that was internet-facing.
immediate_action.title: Patch every internet-facing NetScaler ADC/Gateway now and check for pre-patch compromise

items.headline: Two JFrog Artifactory bugs patched weeks ago are confirmed chained into full admin takeover

immediate_action.action: Wiz Research confirms active, ongoing exploitation of this two-CVE chain against self-hosted JFrog Artifactory since 15 August 2026, reaching full administrative control and, in multiple cases, a dropped Rust-based backdoor with C2 capability. Six weeks after disclosure, most organizations running Artifactory still have at least one vulnerable instance. Upgrade every instance to 7.133.11 or later, JFrog's only fixed build for CVE-2026-42016, on a build that also carries the CVE-2026-42018 fix for its branch. Wiz lists 7.133.29, 7.146.38 and 7.161.20 for those branches, above JFrog's own table. Wiz's lower-branch builds 7.111.21, 7.117.28 and 7.125.20 stay inside JFrog's affected range for CVE-2026-42016. Then search access logs for the chain's own signature: an unauthenticated POST to /access/api/v1/aws/token/ followed by a POST to /access/api/v1/tokens from the same client (in some cases Wiz saw an admin account created within five minutes of the first request). A hit where both requests returned HTTP 200 is a successful exploitation: treat the instance as compromised. Revoke all tokens, reset the Access token signing key and certificate, audit for administrator accounts you did not create, remove unauthorized Groovy plugins and restart the JVM to clear any in-memory implant.
immediate_action.title: Patch and hunt JFrog Artifactory now: confirmed admin-takeover chain, backdoors already dropped

items.summary: ConnectWise says it identified unauthorized access to application identities of its Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) service; Huntress and Todyl report that from 15 October the app's credential was used to obtain app-only Microsoft Graph tokens in customer Microsoft 365 tenants; Huntress alone confirmed unauthorized sign-ins in 162 tenants by 16 October and saw ConnectWise Cloud Management apps assign themselves directory roles in about 50 tenants and, in two tenants, a scripted Global Administrator self-grant followed by new client secrets planted on apparently random applications. items.headline: The Joomla extension disclosure wave adds a cookie-forgery auth bypass, one anonymous request reaches Super User, and Super User means PHP
items.summary: The mySites.guru research campaign against Joomla third-party extensions produced six further disclosures between 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-23, and one of them changes technique class: the Balbooa Gridbox page builder (CVE-2026-61425) trusts a client-supplied cookie value as proof of identity, so setting an administrator's username in that cookie authenticates the requester as that user with no password and no existing session. A Joomla Super User can edit templates, which is PHP execution, so this is full site compromise from a single anonymous request. Fixed in Gridbox 2.20.1; the vulnerable code had shipped since October 2025. The same week added unauthenticated SQL injection and order-forgery flaws in EasyStore, an invoice IDOR in Events Booking, and a critical unauthenticated upload in Membership Pro. A follow-up audit of Gridbox produced eleven more CVEs, fixed in 2.20.2, four of them exploited in the wild, and Gridbox 2.20.3.1 (21 September) fixes a further unauthenticated SQL injection present in every earlier build. Gridbox 2.20.4.2 (27 October) fixes two more unauthenticated SQL injections, CVE-2026-102788 and CVE-2026-102789, with no exploitation reported.

items.headline: Metabase Cloud was breached through its own 0-day; self-hosted instances stay vulnerable until manually upgraded
items.summary: Metabase disclosed on 2026-08-06 that its Metabase Cloud platform was attacked through a previously unknown vulnerability in versions 1.58 and above: an unauthenticated attacker injects arbitrary SQL against the application database and obtains administrator access to the instance, from which they can rewrite configuration, steal the stored credentials for every connected database and export the data those connections reach. The only interim workaround the vendor offers is to block the /api/session/reset_password endpoint, which is also where its published attack pattern runs. Cloud instances were patched by the vendor; self-hosted deployments stay vulnerable until manually upgraded to 0.58.24, 0.59.21, 0.60.17, 0.61.11, 0.62.9 or 0.63.5. Laptop maker Framework and form builder Tally confirmed customer data was taken from instances accessed on 2026-08-03. The flaw had no CVE identifier at disclosure; it is now tracked as CVE-2026-72898, which CISA added to its KEV catalog on 2026-08-11. VenariX now tracks fifteen publicly confirmed downstream incidents and ties two of them, at Statista and Dodo Payments, to the Dire Wolf extortion group working against self-hosted instances.

items.headline: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys install backdoor plugins on WordPress sites; the plugin update alone does not evict them
items.summary: TeamUpdraft, the vendor of the UpdraftPlus backup plugin, says unauthorised access to teamupdraft.com on 17 and 18 October probably exposed its customer database, including UpdraftCentral connection keys, and Patchstack and Nethemba report an attacker using those keys to install backdoor plugins on connected WordPress sites, which Patchstack's telemetry dates from 2026-10-18 15:32 (it gives no time zone), and that create hidden administrators. It is not a flaw in UpdraftPlus: the plugin obeys commands signed with a valid key, a key exists on many sites that never used the service because connecting a teamupdraft.com account ticks the option by default, and the update disconnects only connections made before 13:07 BST (12:07 UTC) on 18 October, so keys created later that day have to be deleted by hand. TeamUpdraft says the attacker used a compromised key to enter its own site, and Nethemba saw the stolen keys used again on 2026-10-21, after 1.26.13 shipped.

items.headline: ANSSI says the refrigeration attacks used exposure and weak passwords, not published flaws; NCSC.ch rates them exploited
items.summary: Coopérative U, Intermarché and E. Leclerc confirmed to AFP a cyberattack on their refrigeration systems overnight on 11 to 12 October 2026, which BFMTV reports as a remotely forced defrost at hundreds of stores. CERT-FR's alert, last revised on 2026-10-16, reports numerous compromises of Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC controllers and of Copeland xweb and Dixell xweb, says campaigns are probably still running and that a factory reset alone does not protect an unpatched end-of-life unit, and in its current text tells owners to check the whole configuration, defrost ranges included, and to restart or otherwise factory-reset a compromised Danfoss unit. NCSC Switzerland rates the activity actively exploited, and Copeland's own bulletin of 14 October, carried in a Dixell France guide that CERT-FR links, acknowledges a vulnerability on a discontinued, end-of-life generation of XWEB EVO controllers and says to remove every XWEB EVO from the public internet at once. Danfoss says most affected units are legacy products or current AK-SM800A units on outdated firmware. ANSSI's director general told the French Senate on 2026-10-21 that elementary flaws were exploited, starting with controllers directly on the internet, administered without particular protection, and weak passwords, rather than vulnerabilities researchers had published; no source names an actor, and the Paris prosecutor is investigating.

actions: Audit every npm publish token your organisation and its maintainers hold and revoke any that can publish without two-factor authentication: that exact token property, not package popularity, is what decides whether the worm spreads from a compromised developer to your packages.

On any developer workstation or build agent that installed a package from the keyv family since 2026-08-04, or tensorlake@0.5.144 since 2026-10-08, treat the AI-assistant, cloud, GitHub, Vault, SSH and Kubernetes credentials present on that host as disclosed and rotate them; the collector sweeps over 300 credential patterns in one pass, so partial rotation leaves the operator a working set. Isolate the host before revoking its GitHub token, because OX Security reports a switch that wipes the machine when the token is revoked; on a host that ran tensorlake@0.5.144, Socket and OX Security also name a token-monitor persistence (a systemd user unit on Linux, a LaunchAgent on macOS, a scheduled task on Windows), which has to be removed before the token is revoked.

Stop treating a valid npm provenance attestation as evidence a package is clean; where release pipelines gate on provenance, change the check to pin on the workflow identity inside the Fulcio certificate and the Rekor log index, which is what Unit 42 says still discriminates.
items.headline: A self-propagating npm worm reaches packages totalling 1.3 billion monthly downloads, and its C2 address lives on-chain
items.summary: Elastic Security Labs identified CHAINDROP on 2026-08-04, a new wave of the Shai-Hulud npm worm that began with the compromise of the keyv maintainer and has backdoored over 400 npm packages whose combined reach Elastic puts at more than 1.3 billion monthly downloads, keyv alone at over 600 million. Execution comes from a package.json preinstall hook that downloads the Bun runtime to run an obfuscated 711 KB payload, which harvests over 300 credential patterns (AI-assistant tokens, AWS/GCP/Azure/Alibaba credentials, GitHub tokens, Vault tokens, SSH keys and Kubernetes service-account tokens) and self-propagates only when it finds an npm token that both carries package-write permission and can publish without two-factor authentication. Rather than hardcoding a command-and-control domain, CHAINDROP queries an Ethereum smart contract at runtime to resolve where to send the stolen material, so the operator rotates infrastructure without shipping a new payload. On 2026-10-08 a release of the tensorlake npm SDK carried the same payload family with valid build provenance, and Socket and OX Security describe a dead-man switch that wipes the owner's home directory if the stolen GitHub token is revoked before its persistence is removed.

actions: Upgrade every Gitea Docker instance that runs with ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTHENTICATION = true to 1.26.4, or until then set REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES to the authenticating proxy's exact address, internet-reachable instances first.

items.headline: Gitea Docker instances with reverse-proxy login enabled accepted a spoofed login header from anyone, and NCSC-CH rates it exploited
items.summary: Gitea's official Docker image hard-coded REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES to the trust-all wildcard, so on instances where an administrator enabled reverse-proxy authentication, anyone who can reach the container's HTTP port can send an X-WEBAUTH-USER header and be signed in as any user whose login name is known or guessable, admins included (CVE-2026-20896, CVSS 9.8). items.summary: FortiBleed is an active credential-compromise campaign against internet-facing FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways, with SOCRadar counting more than 86,644 compromised devices in 194 countries; Fortinet said in June that it uses no new vulnerability, only reused credentials and brute force. items.summary: Atlassian's advisory of 2026-10-05 fixes CVE-2026-21589, an unauthenticated arbitrary file access flaw in every version of Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Jira Software, Bamboo and Crowd Data Center, plus Crucible and Fisheye (CVSS 4.0 9.3), and tells customers to patch immediately or take internet-facing instances off the internet. watchTowr Labs published the root cause, the request shape and a runnable checker on 2026-10-06, and exploitation attempts followed the same day: Previdian's honeypot sensors recorded attempts from dozens of addresses in about twenty countries, SANS ISC recorded similar attempts on its own honeypots, and a Nuclei template exists; neither honeypot operator reports a compromise. CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-15 on evidence of active exploitation, without saying what the evidence is. Where Jira is integrated with Crowd, the file read exposes a plaintext Crowd application password that gives access to Crowd as an administrator of that application. The record for this ID was marked rejected on 2026-10-16 with only a generic reason and ENISA's database shows it restored with its full description on 2026-10-19, while Atlassian's advisory and fixed versions read unchanged, so tooling keyed on the ID may have dropped the flaw in between.

items.summary: PaperCut NG and PaperCut MF (all versions) carry an unauthenticated remote-code-execution chain, CVE-2026-81578 (auth bypass, CVSS4.0 8.8) and CVE-2026-82078 (unsafe dynamic class loading, CVSS4.0 9.4), that PaperCut confirmed under active exploitation on 2026-08-27, before any CVE or patch existed. Fully tested maintenance releases 26.0.5, 25.0.13 and 24.1.10 (10 September 2026) replace the emergency patches and are the vendor's recommended build (the September bulletin, revised 2026-10-13, now names 24.1.11 for v24); servers still on Emergency Patch Release 1 or 2 need to upgrade now. There is no fix for v23 and earlier, and Huntress estimated on 28 August that 47% of the PaperCut installs it tracks ran v23 or older. GreyNoise now documents an AI-agent-orchestrated mass-exploitation campaign against this same chain, compromising at least 440 instances across 395 identified organizations since 31 August 2026, reaching full domain admin in as little as five minutes via legacy Active Directory escalation paths. watchTowr's write-up of 2026-10-09 shows the 28 August emergency build could still be taken without authentication through the Setup Wizard forms, and names CVE-2026-82077, an administrator-only Scan-to-Fax code-execution flaw that the vendor lists as fixed in 26.0.5, 25.0.13 and 24.1.10. Hunt.io's recovery of the attacker's open directories (2026-10-15) adds a second route to code execution through PaperCut's XML-RPC API, usable when its address allowlist is too permissive or no explicit token is set, a cron-kept reverse SOCKS tunnel, and live pivots into 45 victims, with Switzerland among the countries listed.

items.headline: An attacker can reconstruct admin credentials for an exposed refrigeration controller offline, then silently disable cooling while the display reports normal
items.summary: Claroty Team82 disclosed 23 vulnerabilities (21 high) in Copeland XWEB300D/500D/500B PRO supervisory refrigeration controllers. Three chain to unauthenticated root RCE: an auth-bypass logic flaw in the Lua authentication handler, a deterministic admin-password generator derivable offline from the device's MAC address and current date, and an unauthenticated OS command injection via the libraries installation route. 18 further, authenticated-only command-injection flaws score CVSS 8.0 each, and CISA's advisory adds two low-severity unauthenticated flaws. Copeland fixed all 23 in firmware v1.13; no source read reports exploitation of these flaws, but CERT-FR's alert of 2026-10-13 now reports numerous compromises of Copeland xweb refrigeration controllers without naming models, flaws or the entry vector.

items.headline: Microsoft: Teams help-desk vishing into Quick Assist ended in AD CS certificates for privileged accounts and a DC
items.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence describes two human-operated intrusions, not attributed to any actor, in which an external Teams contact impersonating help-desk staff got a user to open Quick Assist, after which the operator staged a portable runtime and used Active Directory Certificate Services to reach privileged identities: a template open to ESC1 issued certificates for privileged accounts and DCSync followed within seconds, and in the second case PetitPotam was relayed to AD CS Web Enrollment (ESC8) for a certificate for a domain controller account. An issued certificate stays valid after a password reset or a reimage of the first workstation, and in the first case one privileged account excluded from automated containment stayed usable and was used to copy data to an external SFTP destination.

items.headline: Cursor marketplace served a trojanised Claude Code extension for 11 hours; uninstalling leaves the SSH backdoor
items.summary: Between about 09:27 and 20:35 UTC on 2026-10-29 the Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace served a modified copy of Anthropic's Claude Code extension, versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 for macOS and Windows, that appends an attacker's SSH key to authorized_keys, tries to enable SSH and open a reverse tunnel, and installs persistence that outlives the extension. Coding errors made the SSH step fail on most standard-user hosts, so Cursor and Sophos say the attacker could not log in there, but the key, the persistence and a host report were still written. Anthropic told Microsoft its systems were not compromised, and no source says how the attacker published under Anthropic's name.

items.headline: Linux TCP use-after-free: Anthropic built a remote root exploit; Ubuntu and RHEL kernels still unfixed
items.summary: The Linux kernel CVE team published CVE-2026-98432 on 2026-10-15, a use-after-free in the IPv4 TCP connection setup path that dates to Linux 4.4 and is reached by a SYN packet carrying IP options; the CNA scores it CVSS 9.8. Anthropic reports that Claude wrote an exploit giving a remote, unauthenticated attacker root command execution on servers with a multipath TCP (MPTCP) listener, and the Go team says the bug is not specific to MPTCP and that Go programs enable MPTCP on Linux listeners by default. Debian's security kernels are fixed while Ubuntu 22.04 to 26.10 and RHEL 8 to 10 had no fixed kernel on 2026-10-30; no source reports public exploit code or attacks.

As of 2026-10-28 (revision V1.2) the table lists QVR Surveillance (ARM32) 3.0.3.1756, TVR OS 1.0.5 and Notes Station 3 3.9.15 as resolved; QNE (ADRA) has its own advisory, QSA-26-19, with no fixed version and QNAP says to keep devices off the internet; QNAP has seen scanning and exploitation attempts in the wild but no reports of exploitation targeting its products, and CISA added both flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-26. Synology's advisory fixes its PHP packages (except the end-of-life PHP 7.3), Mail Station and Calendar.

items.headline: WordPress 7.1.4 fixes an unauthenticated upgrade-window RCE race; Wordfence sees probing, so confirm the auto-update ran
items.summary: WordPress 7.1.4 of 2026-10-28 fixes a weakness in the core upgrade process that lets an unauthenticated attacker reach the staged installer and run code on the server during a full-package core update, in versions 4.7 to 7.1.3, with backports for every branch down to 4.7. Wordfence reports more than 18,500 probing requests in the first 21 hours, while Patchstack calls the race hard to win and says it needs a web-reachable staging directory; no source gives a CVE identifier.

items.headline: SafeDep and JFrog: the testmetest npm worm now runs on import, so --ignore-scripts does not stop it; 42 repos armed
items.summary: SafeDep and JFrog describe an npm worm, tracked as testmetest, whose newest builds start when an application imports the package, so installing with --ignore-scripts does not stop it. It steals SSH, registry, cloud, CI and AI-tool credentials, publishes new patch versions of the victim's own packages, and wipes the home directory when the stolen GitHub token is revoked. SafeDep counts 19 packages from one operator between 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-27; JFrog found 42 armed GitHub repositories of 11 legitimate owners; neither lab names an actor.

items.headline: ESET: an emailed RAR ran code on MDaemon servers via ClamAV's UnRAR; fixed in MDaemon 26.0.4, ClamAV 1.4.6 and 1.5.4
items.summary: ESET reports an active campaign in Ukraine in which Russia-aligned attackers exploited MDaemon mail servers: a crafted RAR archive mailed to any address makes MDaemon invoke ClamAV, whose old bundled UnRAR library carries the path-traversal flaw CVE-2025-8088, and the exploit writes a malicious DLL to the server with no user interaction. MDaemon fixed it in 26.0.4 on 2026-08-25, and ClamAV's own notes show that every Windows ClamAV from 0.101.0 to 1.5.3 is affected, fixed in 1.4.6 and 1.5.4. The attackers deployed the HELLAGE mail-stealing backdoor and the Telegram-controlled HELLTAG backdoor.

items.headline: Huntress: phished MDM enrolments push ScreenConnect back after removal; the RMM is not the root of the intrusion
items.summary: Huntress reports several recent incidents in which phishing victims ended up with an MDM client from Hexnode or Rippling followed by an unauthorised ScreenConnect agent. In the Rippling case the attacker used the MDM, running with SYSTEM rights, to stage and run ScreenConnect; in the Hexnode case the managed-service provider removed ScreenConnect and it returned several hours later to the same relay while the Hexnode client was still installed. Huntress says the products are not at fault and that removing the RMM does not remove the management architecture behind it.

items.headline: DeadTag: expired tag domains send visitors to iPhone exploit kits; opening the page is enough on vulnerable iOS
items.summary: Report URI and iVerify report that an operator they call DeadTag buys the expired domains of old analytics and advertising tags that thousands of websites still load, so every page that carries the tag runs the operator's script, and sells the visitors on; Report URI counts more than 660 re-registered domains. For chosen iPhone visitors one chain ends at a page that serves the Coruna kit to iOS 13 to 17.2.1 and a modified DarkSword kit to iOS 18.4 to 18.7, both of which attack the browser itself, so that opening the page compromises a vulnerable device and steals keychain passwords and crypto-wallet data.

items.headline: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and in the official images stole cloud and AI credentials; removing the package does not stop it
items.summary: On 2026-10-21 LiteLLM 1.107.0, the open-source LLM gateway, shipped with malicious Python startup files in all seven PyPI wheels (live 11:39 to 13:23 UTC) and in the official GHCR and Docker Hub images behind the v1.107.0, latest, main-latest and main-stable tags (11:46 to 14:20 UTC); they run a credential stealer at every Python start and start a background loader that could execute code fetched from an attacker-chosen host, though Socket saw its pointer empty at 13:01 UTC. The maintainers' root-cause post of 2026-10-23 says a master key committed to a public repository on 2026-05-27 and never revoked gave the attacker, from 2026-10-10, a GitHub organization owner's CLI token, with which it stole two maintainers' tokens and, on 2026-10-21, overrode branch protection to build the release from a look-alike repository; Socket independently found secret-stealing workflows running on 2026-10-10. items.headline: Eight eMudhra CA keys were guessable; Java needs a second update, and Python, Go, Rust and curl stacks need theirs
items.summary: On 2026-10-17 a researcher reported that the private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates had been generated with too little randomness, so anyone could recover them and forge trusted HTTPS certificates for any site. Firefox, Chrome, Apple and Microsoft platforms block the intermediates and eMudhra revoked them, but software that keeps its own trust store or does not check revocation stays exposed until updated: Go fixed it in 1.27.3 and 1.26.10 as CVE-2026-111943, Python added a built-in denylist as CVE-2026-115557, and Oracle and OpenJDK's Java update of 2026-10-21 (CVE-2026-91403) was followed on 2026-10-24 by a second alert, CVE-2026-114820 (CVSS 3.1 9.1), that removes four root CAs and that OpenJDK says even a runtime updated in the past few days needs. items.headline: Brevo's own integrity checks never saw the tampering because the attacker rewrote pages at Cloudflare's edge, not on Brevo's servers
items.summary: Brevo (CRM/email platform, formerly Sendinblue) confirmed a stolen long-lived Cloudflare API key let an attacker deploy a malicious edge Worker that rewrote Brevo's own pages from 15:01 to 20:30 UTC on 2026-09-14 and, from 16:07 UTC, three customer-embedded widget scripts, serving a ClickFix clipboard-paste lure and a WordPress administrator-backdoor plugin without modifying any origin file. Sansec says Brevo served malware to visitors of more than 100,000 customer sites, a figure it links to a public source-code search for pages mentioning Brevo's domains. BleepingComputer reports the same research as up to 100,000 sites using the affected components.

items.headline: Fifty credential-free, no-interaction flaws span Oracle's middleware, ERP, BI and telco-assurance lines in an off-quarter patch release
items.summary: Oracle's September 2026 Critical Security Patch Update, published 2026-09-15, carries 673 patches of which 153 are for Fusion Middleware, and Oracle states 78 of those may be exploited over a network without credentials. Oracle's own risk matrix lists fifty CVEs at CVSS 9.8-10.0 that are network-reachable without privileges or user interaction and marked remotely exploitable without authentication. Six are CVSS 10.0 flaws in WebLogic Server, Access Manager, Forms, Internet Directory, Platform Security for Java and Hyperion Financial Management, and forty-four are CVSS 9.8 flaws across Fusion Middleware (Access Manager, Forms, Internet Directory and Platform Security for Java again, plus Data Integrator, Identity Manager, JDeveloper, WebCenter Enterprise Capture/Portal/Sites, WebLogic Server and Service Delivery Platform) and other product lines: E-Business Suite, Hyperion Financial Management, Business Intelligence/BI Publisher, Enterprise Manager, Communications Unified Assurance and Product Lifecycle Analytics. No exploitation is reported for any of the fifty. The release is Oracle's off-quarter patch line, which a calendar built only on the quarterly dates will miss.

items.headline: A validator that strips quoted text before inspecting it, and an agent instruction file rewritten between two passes of one shared checkout
items.summary: Novee Security's Black Hat USA 2026 write-up root-causes trust-boundary failures in AI coding-agent CI harnesses, each tested against the vendor's own public repository in default configuration. Against Claude Code Action it reports three successive rounds of patch-and-bypass, of which only the last (an allowlist entry that pre-approved a bare hostname for the fetch tool) carries CVE-2026-54316; the two more instructive rounds, a command validator that strips single-quoted content before inspecting it and a read-only allowlist exempt from path checking, carry no identifier. Google's advisory for the Gemini CLI findings, aliased CVE-2026-12537, hardens headless folder trust and tool allowlisting under yolo mode. The third finding, an OpenAI Codex workflow whose two agent passes shared one checkout so the first could rewrite the instruction file the second treats as authoritative, has no CVE and was fixed only in the vendor's own repository.

items.headline: GhostAction: fake security workflows now harvest whole git histories; rotating Actions secrets is not enough
items.summary: StepSecurity and Socket report that on 2026-10-08 the GhostAction campaign used the GitHub credentials of two open-source maintainers to commit a workflow disguised as a security audit straight to the default branch of 345 to 346 repositories, including one of an Uber-owned organisation, and that the workflow now sends the credentials found in the working tree and in the entire git history, besides the named Actions secrets, to a hardcoded address over plain HTTP. GitGuardian's own data puts the wave of 8 to 12 October at more than 30,000 repositories reached through about 1,900 compromised GitHub accounts, and says GitHub has prevented the workflow from running since 9 October; no malicious package release from the stolen credentials had been seen as of 2026-10-09.
